QRectF contentsRect() const.brief: Returns the contents rect in local coordinates.

void setMinimumSize(qreal w, qreal h).brief: This convenience function is equivalent to calling setMinimumSize([QSizeF](xref:qt:QSizeF)(*w*, *h*)).
